thread:
aria: ok team — putting together the launch sprint for the new OSS starter (Sketchpad). timeline proposal: blog + benchmark post, 60-min webinar, and a linked refapp repo + tutorial. who can own the webinar ops?
matt: I can own webinar ops and registration flow. thinking Wed May 22 11am PT.
aria: sounds good. aim to have blog + bench live 3 days before so we can drive pre-reads.
devin: bench narrative: show latency/cost at 1k/5k concurrent tokens, include comparison vs vanilla HF spool. i'll draft numbers. quick ask: do we want to surface p95 and token cost per 1k?
matt: yes p95 + cost per 1k tokens. also include a small table of model variants we used (quantized vs fp16).
devin: noted. i'll upload the raw csv to the drive and make a chart. link preview when ready.
sophia: I'll handle webinar copy + slide deck outline. need a co-host who can demo the refapp and answer infra questions. @jen possible?
jen: yep can demo the refapp and repo walkthrough. i'll prep a 10-min live demo (git + run locally).
jen: quick note on demo script — prefer to use this quick start command to show local inference:
```
git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/sketchpad-refapp.git
cd sketchpad-refapp
docker compose up --build
# open http://localhost:3000
```
oliver: I'll design the hero image + webinar banner. can someone drop 2 short blurbs (30/140 chars) for the banner and social?
aria: I'll draft both. short blurb: "Ship a production-ready LLM refapp in under an hour — Sketchpad + Redwood inference." longer (140): "Try Sketchpad: an OSS starter that pairs Redwood Inference serving best-practices with a hands-on refapp. Join our webinar to see live demos, benchmarks, and migration tips."
matt: registration asks: name, email, company, use-case checkbox (research, product, infra). keep it 2-min to register.
sophia: will set up the registration page and calendar invite. who will own follow-up nurture (email sequence)?
aria: marketing will own nurture: 3 emails — day 0 (thanks + assets), day 2 (bench highlights), day 7 (on-demand + starter checklist).
devin: bench highlights copy: "Sketchpad on Redwood: 2-3x lower cost per 1k tokens with smart batching & KV caching; p95 latency under 220ms for short conversations." I'll refine with final numbers.
jen: for the refapp README, please include a short troubleshooting section for common Docker errors and a small note about GPU support. i'll add that.
launch-bot: deploy-check: staging docs site build passed (ci/website #482) :white_check_mark: 
aria: great. next — inbound lead routing. @matt can you map which leads go to growth vs sales? we want product/infrastructure leads routed to AE; research & dev sandbox folks to growth/nurture.
matt: yes. rule set: company domain with >50 employees -> AE, otherwise growth. use-case=infra -> AE override. implement in HubSpot + webhook to our lead-scoring lambda.
sophia: will we tag leads with 'sketchpad-webinar' and bench interest boolean?
matt: yes please. tag: sketchpad_webinar=true; bench_interest=true if they view bench link.
oliver: assets needed for social: 1x hero png, 1x 1200x628 banner, 3 short clips (10s) from the demo. timeline for assets?
aria: oliver, can you drop hero + banner by EOD Fri? jen can record demo clips on Thurs.
oliver: yes EOD Fri works.
jen: recording scheduled Thu 10am. will upload raw clips to drive and mark take timestamps.
devin: final bench CSV ETA: Thu EOD. i'll also add a short methodology note in the repo under /bench/README.md.
sophia: webinar moderator & handoff notes: opening 5m, product talk 10m, demo 10m, bench walkthrough 10m, Q&A 20m, wrap 5m. record session and attach to nurture.
matt: approved. will set up runbook and rehearsals Tue before.
aria: OK owners recap: blog + bench post -> devin (draft), aria (edit/publish). Webinar ops + registration -> matt. Webinar deck copy -> sophia. Demo + refapp walkthrough -> jen. Design assets -> oliver. Nurture + follow-up -> aria. Lead routing rules -> matt.
aria: can everyone add a quick reaction below when your tasks are feasible? :thumbsup:
matt: 👍
devin: 👍
sophia: 👍
oliver: 👍
jen: 👍
aria: perfect. I'll create the final checklist in the marketing drive and ping this thread when the draft blog is live for review. thanks all!
